title.en-US: Installed is not the same as enabled

body.zh-CN: AI 工具是否可被模型调用，由「AI 控制台 → 用途 → forum.reply」的工具白名单决定。请在那一页把「自定义」打开并加入 fetch-url，否则模型看不到这个工具。
body.en-US: Whether the model may call this tool is decided by the purpose tool allowlist in AI console → Purposes → forum.reply. Switch that purpose to Custom and add fetch-url, or the model never sees the tool.

title.zh-CN: 白名单为空 = 拒绝一切抓取
title.en-US: An empty allowlist denies every fetch

body.zh-CN: 本插件不提供「全部放行」模式。至少填一个域名，抓取才会发生；未命中的域名会作为可解释失败回给模型。
body.en-US: This plugin has no allow-all mode. Add at least one domain before any fetch can happen; a miss is returned to the model as an explainable failure.

title.zh-CN: 使用代理时会跳过本机 IP 校验
title.en-US: A proxy disables the local IP check

body.zh-CN: 配置代理后，域名由代理解析，本插件无法预知真实出口 IP，因此只保留「拒绝字面私有地址与 localhost/.local/.internal」这一层。请确认你的代理本身可信。
body.en-US: With a proxy configured the name is resolved by the proxy, so the plugin cannot verify the real outbound IP; only the literal private-address and localhost/.local/.internal rejections remain. Make sure the proxy itself is trusted.

description.zh-CN: 关闭后插件保持启用，但每次调用都会返回「抓取功能当前已关闭」的可解释失败。它不影响工具在 AI 控制台里的可见性。
description.en-US: When off, the plugin stays enabled but every call returns an explainable "fetch is currently disabled" failure. It does not change tool visibility in the AI console.

description.zh-CN: 每行一个域名，也可以英文逗号分隔；以 # 开头的行视为注释。填 example.com 会同时放行它的子域；写 *.example.com 只放行子域、不放行 example.com 本身。留空表示拒绝一切抓取。
description.en-US: One domain per line, or comma-separated; lines starting with # are comments. example.com also allows its subdomains; *.example.com allows subdomains only, not example.com itself. An empty list denies every fetch.

description.zh-CN: 默认只允许 https。仅在抓取只有 http 的站点（例如内网文档站）时打开；打开后这些请求不带传输层加密。
description.en-US: Only https is allowed by default. Turn this on only for sites that serve http (for example an internal doc host); those requests then have no transport encryption.

description.zh-CN: 留空表示直连。支持 http、https、socks5 三种代理，例如 http://127.0.0.1:7897 或 socks5://127.0.0.1:1080。当前不支持代理认证。
description.en-US: Leave blank to connect directly. http, https, and socks5 proxies are supported, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Proxy authentication is not supported yet.

description.zh-CN: 包含连接、重定向与读取的总预算，可填 1000–4500。AI 工具本身在宿主侧有 5000 毫秒硬上限，因此这里不会允许填更大。
description.en-US: Total budget covering connect, redirects, and read; 1000–4500. The AI tool has a hard 5000 ms host-side ceiling, so larger values are not accepted.

description.zh-CN: 只读取这么多字节再抽取正文，可填 16384–1048576。模型最终能看到的正文还会被宿主截断到 8000 字节，所以调大只对长页面有意义。
description.en-US: Only this many bytes are read before extraction; 16384–1048576. The model still sees at most 8000 bytes because the host truncates tool results, so raising this only matters for long pages.

description.zh-CN: 只给下面「测试抓取」按钮使用，不参与 AI 工具的实际抓取行为。建议填一个你确定在白名单里的页面。
description.en-US: Used only by the Test fetch button below; it does not affect what the AI tool fetches. Prefer a page you know is inside the allowlist.

description.zh-CN: 用上面的草稿值（白名单、代理、超时等）对「测试目标地址」做一次真实抓取。它不受「启用网页抓取」开关影响：要回答的是「按当前配置能不能抓」。
description.en-US: Perform one real fetch of the probe target using the draft values above (allowlist, proxy, timeout). It ignores the enable switch: it answers "can this configuration fetch?".
